GPTR-F-001-S84.title: Negative Path and Fuzz Testing for Scope Violations
GPTR-F-001-S84.description: Implement comprehensive negative tests and fuzz inputs to verify that malformed, overbroad, or adversarial queries are consistently rejected by the enforcement engine without execution.

GPTR-F-001-S85.title: Auth Scope Alignment with Allowlist Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S85.description: Ensure enforcement logic is aligned with bearer token scope validation so that only authorized identities can access permitted collections, preventing scope bypass via valid tokens.

GPTR-F-001-S86.title: Allowlist Configuration Management and Versioning
GPTR-F-001-S86.description: Implement centralized configuration loading and version control for the allowlist schema, enabling safe updates and rollback without code changes.

GPTR-F-001-S87.title: End-to-End Integration with Mongo Query Execution Path
GPTR-F-001-S87.description: Validate that only enforcement-approved queries reach MongoDB execution layer and confirm no bypass paths exist between Azure Function entry and database access.
